Sales Enablement & AI Intern - Fall 2026

Mississauga, ON

Bellhaven Health Partners is an impact-driven healthcare distribution company serving independent pharmacies across Canada.

About the Opportunity

You will support our commercial enablement team by building sales enablement content, maintaining CRM reporting, and piloting AI-assisted workflows for the field sales organization.

Responsibilities

- Maintain sales enablement collateral and onboarding materials
- Support CRM reporting and pipeline management dashboards
- Pilot AI-assisted workflows for the field sales team

Qualifications

- Enrolled in a business, commerce, or analytics program
- Strong written communication skills

Location: Mississauga, ON (Hybrid)

Work Term: Fall 2026 - September 8th through December 31st

Compensation: $17.69 - $22.21

Applications are reviewed as they are received.
